mechanism_narrative: A sustained two-week rebound in WORKPLACES mobility, indicating a return to offices, will gradually increase weekday retail and recreation visits, leading to higher RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days, despite WORKPLACES showing a clear upward trend for the past two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A significant week-on-week increase in TRANSIT mobility, exceeding 5 points, signals a critical shift in public transport usage that will directly boost retail and recreation activity within the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises by more than 5 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase over the next 14 days, even if TRANSIT mobility rises by more than 5 points week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: When WORKPLACES mobility increases while RESIDENTIAL mobility simultaneously decreases, it indicates a shift from home-based activities to out-of-home activities, driving up RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than the previous 28 days, despite WORKPLACES rising and RESIDENTIAL falling in the current period.

mechanism_narrative: A recent drop in RESIDENTIAL mobility, especially after a period of high residential activity, suggests an easing of stay-at-home behaviors, which will translate to increased RETAIL_REC within the next week.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not show an increase in the immediate next week, even if RESIDENTIAL mobility has declined.

mechanism_narrative: The recent stability of RETAIL_REC at a low level, following a period of decline, indicates a floor has been reached, and any minor positive shifts in other categories will prevent further decline, leading to stable or slightly higher RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC continues its decline over the next 28 days, falling below the current -16% baseline.

mechanism_narrative: High volatility in PARKS mobility, especially a sharp recent increase, suggests a population seeking outdoor activities, which often precedes or coincides with increased general out-of-home activity, boosting RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS changes by more than 10 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase over the next 14 days, despite a significant week-on-week change in PARKS mobility.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in TRANSIT usage and a decrease in GROCERY_PHARM visits suggests a shift from essential, localized trips to broader, discretionary travel, which will positively impact RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than the previous 28 days, even if TRANSIT rises and GROCERY_PHARM falls.

mechanism_narrative: Despite a strong rebound in WORKPLACES mobility, if RETAIL_REC remains flat or declines, it indicates a persistent shift towards remote work or reduced discretionary spending, leading to continued low RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises by >10 points week-on-week while RETAIL_REC remains flat (<1 point change)
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC shows a significant increase over the next 28 days, despite the observed divergence between WORKPLACES and RETAIL_REC.
